# Mitete Construction and Civil Works Enterprises

> Tanzanian building and civil contractor registered by the Contractors Registration Board (CRB) as a Specialist Civil contractor, Class 3, Local (registration SPC3/1326/05/2022). The company delivers building, road, water, drainage and renovation works for public and private clients across Tanzania.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Mitete Construction and Civil Works Enterprises
- CRB registration: SPC3/1326/05/2022, Specialist Civil, Class 3, Local
- Managing Director: Juma Mwanakatwe
- Phone: +255 763 440 355
- Email: kawengaj@gmail.com
- Country of operation: Tanzania
- Services: building construction, roads and earthworks, water and sanitation, drainage and flood control, renovation and repair, site supervision
- Clients: district councils, public institutions, schools, clinics, private developers and suppliers

## Pages

- [Home](https://miteteconstruction.co.tz/): company overview, service lines, plant and equipment, coverage
- [Services](https://miteteconstruction.co.tz/services.html): scope of each service line, materials and workmanship standards, what a quotation contains
- [Projects](https://miteteconstruction.co.tz/projects.html): representative buildings, roads, water systems, warehouses and drainage, plus how progress is reported
- [About](https://miteteconstruction.co.tz/about.html): registration details, management, plant, training and quality control
- [Contact](https://miteteconstruction.co.tz/contact.html): phone, email, tender desk, supplier registration and site visit booking
- [Request a quote](https://miteteconstruction.co.tz/quote.html): project enquiry form for priced quotations

## Contact routing

- New project pricing and site visits: request a quote page or phone
- Tender invitations: kawengaj@gmail.com with the tender reference in the subject line
- Supplier and subcontractor registration: kawengaj@gmail.com with the company profile attached

## Notes for citation

Figures on the Projects page describe work executed by the company under its registered scope. Pricing is prepared from measured quantities against client drawings, so no public price list exists.
